translations.source: Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụ oke ọnwa anọ na-arịabu ọrịa shuga mana ha anaghị arịazi ya.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, we have four patients with diabetes who are unaware of their condition.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, ọkammụta nke ọgwụ na Mahadum Dalhousie nọ na Halifax, Nova Scotia na onye isi oche nke ngalaba ụlọ ọgwụ na sayensi ahụ nke Òtù Ọrịa Shuga ndị Kanada dọrọ aka na ntị na nnyocha ahụ ka nọ n’oge ndị mbụ ya.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, a professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and the head of the diabetes research division of the Canadian Diabetes Association, provided valuable insights during the early stages of the study.

translations.source: Ka ndị ọkachamara ndị ọzọ, o kwenyeghị na a ga agwọtanwu ọrịa shuga, o depụtara na ihe nchọpụta ndị a enweghị mmetụta nye ndị nwere ọrịa shuga Taịp 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: However, other experts disagree, stating that these findings have no relevance to people with type 1 diabetes.

translations.source: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye odeakwụkwọ Nobel kọmitii maka akwụkwọ agụmagụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ Swidin, kwuputara n'ihu ọha na ihe omume redio na Sveriges Redio dị na Swidin, mgbe o siere kọmitii ahụ ike inweta Bob Dilan gbasara mmeri na ihe nrite Nobel na mpaghara Akwụkwọ agụmagụ nke afọ 2016 o nwetara, na ha ahapụlarị mbọ ha na-agba inweta ya.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the chair of the Swedish Academy's Nobel Committee for Literature, addressed the public and the Swedish Radio, after the committee decided to revoke Bob Dylan's Nobel Prize in Literature that he was awarded in 2016 for his contributions to literature.

translations.source: Danius si, "Ugbu a anyị anaghị eme ihe ọbụla. Akpọọlam oku ma zijere onye ya na ya kacha arụkọ ozi ịntaneetị ma nwetekwa ụsa nnabata. Ugbua nke ahụ zuru oke."
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: Danius replied, "We can't do anything now. I've called the police and they're on their way. In the meantime, let's just stay calm and wait for them to arrive."

translations.source: Na mbu,onye isi Ring, Jamie Siminoff, kwuru na ulo oru ya bidoro mgbe onughi mgbirigba ya n’ulo ahia ya di na ime ebe o na adoba ugboala ya.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: In fact, Jamie Siminoff, the CEO of Ring, stated that his company's doorbell camera malfunctioned when a large branch from a tree fell onto it during a storm.

translations.source: O kwuru na ọ rụrụ mgbịrịgba ụzọ ji WiFi arụ ọrụ.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: I'm saying that I've set up a Wi-Fi-enabled network.

translations.source: Siminoff sị na orire ahịa gbaliri elu ka ogosichara n'ihe nkiri Shak Tank n'afọ 2013 ebe ndị ndozi ihe ngosi jụrụ itinye ego na mbido.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff reported that the price of crude oil had risen sharply in early 2013, prompting oil companies to reconsider their investment plans.

translations.source: Na ngwụcha 2017, e gosiri Siminoff na chanel igbe onyonyo QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: In late 2017, Siminoff was featured on the QVC television channel.

translations.source: Ring dozikwara otu ikpe ha na ụlọ ọrụ ọzọ na-ahụ maka nchekwa, ADT Corporation nwere.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: The ring was discovered at another security company, ADT Corporation.

translations.source: Ọ bụ eziokwu na otu ọgwụ mgbochi aka na-ele anya egosila na o nwere ike ịbelata oke ndị mmadụ ji anwụ n'ihi ọrịa Ebola, mana ruo ugbu a, enwebeghi ọgwụ ọbụla gosiri hooha na o nwere ike ịgwọ onye bu ọrịa a.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: It is true that one experimental drug has shown promise in reducing the number of people who die from Ebola, but so far, there is no drug that has been proven to be effective in treating the disease.

translations.source: Otu antibọdi, ZMapp, gosiburu olileanya, mana ka elebakwuru ya anya, achọpụtara na ọbaghị uru na-igbochi ọnwụ ka esiri chee.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: The ZMapp vaccine, while promising, has not yet been proven to be effective in preventing the disease.

translations.source: Na nnwale PALM, eji ZMapp mere ihe nruba ama, nke a putara na ndi sayentist jiri ya mee baseline tunyere ogwugwo ato ozo.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: The PALM test, developed by ZMapp, is a diagnostic tool that allows scientists to measure the level of viral load in a patient's blood.

translations.source: USA Jimnastiks kwadoro ozi Olimpik Kọmitii Amerịka dere ma kwere kwa na oge eruola mgbe onye ọbụla na-eme Olimpiks aghaghị ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ ịhụ na ndị egwuregwu anyị niile nọ na nchekwa.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics has announced that the American Olympic Committee will implement new safety measures to ensure that all gymnasts are safe during competitions.

translations.source: Anyi kwere na ihe USOC dere na odimma ndi egwuregwu anyi na klob ha nakwa egwuregwu ga enweta uru n’ihu karia ma o buru na enwe mgbanwe n’ulo oru anyi kama inapu ndi mmadu asambodo ha.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We have learned that the USOC has announced its support for the sports program, and we are confident that it will bring success and recognition to our athletes. We are also excited about the potential for this program to create new opportunities for our community.

translations.source: Mpaghara jimnasktik nke obodo USA kwadoro nlebara anya nke onwe nke nwere ike igosi ka mmegbu nke ndị lanarịrị ihe mberede Larị Nassar kọwapụtara nwere ike ịbụ ihe metere aka a na-amaghị maka ya na anabatakwa mgbanwe ndị kwesịrị ekwesị.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: The US Olympic Committee has announced the selection of a new team captain, who is expected to lead the athletes through the challenges of the upcoming Olympic Games.

translations.source: Egwuregwu Jimnastik nke mba USA na ndi USOC nwere otu ebumnobi - ime egwuregwu jimnastik, na ndi ozo, enweghi iyi-egwu dika ike kwere nye ogwu egwu isoro nro ha n’uzo n’enweghi iyi-egwu, ziri-ezi na gburu-gburu akwadoro akwado.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: The US gymnastics team and the USOC had a common goal: to achieve excellence in gymnastics, both in terms of individual performance and as a team, and to overcome the challenges of competition, including injuries and pressure.

translations.source: Na 1960 ga, Brzezinski rụụrụ John F. Kennedy ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ ya ma mechaa rụọkwa otu ihe ahụ n'oge ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: In 1960, Brzezinski served as an advisor to John F. Kennedy and later held a similar position during Lyndon B. Johnson's presidency.

translations.source: N’ime nghọpụta nke 1976, ọ dụrụ Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara iwu ndị mba ofesi, wee rụzie ọrụ dịka Onye ndụmọdụ Nchekwa Mba (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na nnọchi Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: In 1976, Carter received advice on foreign law, and he served as a legal advisor to the National Security Council from 1977 to 1981, under the guidance of Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: Dịka NSA, o nyere Carter aka n’ijikwa ihe omume mbaụwa n’ụzọ kwesiri ekwesi, dị ka Nkwekọrịta Kampụ Devidi, 1978; ihazigharị mmekọrịta US–Chaịna n'afọ ndị dị na ngwụcha agbata afọ 1970 na 1980; Mgbanwe ọchịchị Iran, nke butere nsogbu njigide Iran, 1979; mbuso agha nke Sọviet n’ime Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As a former NSA official, he provided Carter with insights into global affairs, such as the Camp David Accords of 1978; the reshaping of US-China relations in the late 1970s and 1980s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to increased tensions between Iran and the United States in 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

translations.source: Aghoputara ihe nkiri ahu Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone no n’ime ya maka nturu ugo di iche iche.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: I found the acting performances of Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone to be particularly impressive and memorable.

translations.source: E deturu aha Gosling na Stone n'otu ndị nwere ịnweta akara nturu ugo Best Aktọ na Best Aktres, n'otu n'otu.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone are among the nominees for the Best Actor and Best Actress awards.

translations.source: Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ gụnyere Foto Kacha, Onye nhazi, Ọrụ nkiri fiim, Nhazi Kọstuum, Ọrụrụ fiim, Exigbo Egwu fiim Mbu, Nhazi mmeputa, Ọrụrụ Ụda, Mwụghari Ụda na Ezigbo Mmemme mbu.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: Other notable figures include: Photojournalist, Film Director, Costume Designer, Film Editor, Film Producer, Film Actor, Makeup Artist, and Special Effects Artist.

translations.source: Abụ abụọ sitere n’ihenkiri ahụ, Ọdishọn (Onye Iberibe Ahu Rọrọ Nrọ) na Obodo Kpakpandu gasị, nwetara aha maka abụ mbụ kacha mma. N’ihe nlere nke Lionsgate natara ntinye aka 26 — karia ihe ndi a.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two teams, Lionsgate (the reigning champions) and Kpakpandu, competed for the title. Lionsgate ultimately won, securing their second consecutive championship.

translations.source: Ka ụbọchị Sọnde nọ na ngwụcha, Onye isi ọchịchị obodo Yunaịted Steeti bụ Donald Trọmp, kwuru n'ozi e nyere site n'aka onye ode akwụkwọ ndị nta akụkọ, nke sịrị na ndị agha obodo US ga ahapụ Sirịa.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On Sunday, the President of the United States, Donald Trump, announced in a press briefing that American troops would be withdrawn from Syria.

translations.source: E kwuputara nke a mgbe Trump na Onyeisiala mba Tọkị bụ Rejep Tayyip Erdoghan nwechara mkparịtaụka n'ekwentị.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: This occurred when President Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan spoke on the phone.

translations.source: Mba Turkey ga-anarakwa ichebe ndị agha ISIS enwudere ndị, ozi ahụ kwuru, na mba ndị dị na Europe ajụla ịnabata ha ọzọ.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: According to the report, Turkey is preparing to send troops to assist in the fight against ISIS, and European countries are considering how to handle the situation.

translations.source: Nke a na-egosi na, opekata mpe, ụfọdụ daịnosọọ nwere abụba; ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nwere echiche a taa, mana ihe ọzọ bụ na ọ na-egosi anyị ihe fosịl enweghị ike igosi, dịka agba na nhazi akụkụ-atọ.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: What is interesting is that, while some people have this idea, many others do not. However, it does show us something that fossils cannot, such as the color and texture of the original material.

translations.source: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị kwuru na abụba anụmanụ a nwere mgbe ọ na-acha aja aja n'elu ma na-acha ka karotenọịd n'okpuru.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have found that this type of fruit can have a reddish-orange color on the outside and a yellowish-orange color inside.

translations.source: Ihe nchọpụta ahụ nyekwara ntụziaka gbasara mmalite ipu nku n'ụmụ nnụnụ.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The report provided guidance on the proper way to start a fire in a forest.

translations.source: Maka na nku ajọ anụ daịnosọ enweghị akụ toro nke ọma, nke a na akpọ rachis, ma na o nwere ihe ndị ọzọ nke na-enwe - dịka barbs na barbules - ndị nchọpụta ihe kwuru na ọdịka rachis ọbụ ihe mechara si n'ihe ndị ọzọ a were toputa.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: The spines of the cactus are not evenly spaced, and they are also covered in small thorns and barbs, which make it difficult to handle.

translations.source: Nhazi nku ha gosiri na ha ejighi ya efe efe kama ha ji ya edokwa okpomọkụ maọbụ eme ihe ngosi. Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The experiment involved exposing snails to different types of light, including both bright and dim light, to see how it affected their behavior. The researchers found that while bright light did not seem to have a significant effect on the snails' behavior, dim light did cause them to become more active.

translations.source: Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The investigators suggested that, while this was a clear case of animal poaching, the evidence showed that the animal had been killed by a human, not by another animal.

translations.source: Otu bọmbụ gbawara n'isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii n’ime Gaziantep, Tọkii ụtụtụ ụnyaahụ na-egbu ndị uwe ojii abụọ ma merụọ ahụ ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ ọzọ iri abụọ.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: An explosion occurred inside a military base in Gaziantep early this morning, killing two soldiers and injuring more than a dozen others.

translations.source: Ụlọ ọrụ gọvanọ kwuru iri na itoolu na ndị merụrụ ahụ bụ ndị uwe ojii.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The state government stated that 17 people were killed in the accident.

translations.source: Ndị uwe ojii sị na ha na-enyo otu onye a na-ebo ebubo na ọ bụ onye agha nnupuisi Daesh (ISIL) dịka onye mere mwakpo ahụ.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: The witnesses stated that they saw a man who appeared to be a member of the extremist group ISIS (Daesh) carrying out the attack.

translations.source: Ha chọpụtara na Anyanwụ na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ụdị isi iwu dịka kpakpandu ndị ọzọ: A chọpụtara na omume kpakpandu niile nọ na sistemụ bụ onwunwu ọkụ na ntụgharị ha na-anya ha, ma ọ nweghị ihe ọzọ..
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: It has been observed that the south experiences a similar pattern of economic activity as other regions: all economic activities are concentrated in a few key sectors, and there is little diversification.

translations.source: A na-ejikọta ọnụ ọnwụnwụ ọkụ na ntụgharị ya amata akara Rossby nke otu kpakpando, nke metụtara na ọwụwụ plasma.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: It combines the effects of electron beams and the Rossby circulation pattern, which is observed in the plasma region.

translations.source: Ka akara Rossby na-adị obere karịa, ka arụmarụ na-adịkwu obere nke kpakpando n’ikwanye ugwu nye ụmụ ntụgharị nke ihendọta.
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: When the Rossby waves are weak, the pattern of wind circulation around the high-pressure system is less pronounced.

translations.source: Na njem ya, Iwasaki banyere na nsogbu ọtụtụ mgbe.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: I was surprised to learn that Iwasaki had been involved in many problems in the past.

translations.source: Ndị ohi ụgbọ mmiri zuri ya ohi, nkịta ara lụsoro ya ọgụ, o siri na-alụm di na nwunye gbalaga na Nepal a tụọ ya nga na India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: The fishermen cast their nets, the sun beat down on them, and they continued to work tirelessly in the hopes of catching a good haul of fish in Nepal, where they had recently arrived from India.

translations.source: Oke 802.11n na arụ ọrụ ma na frikwensi nke 2.4Ghz na nke 5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n operates on both the 2.4 GHz and 5.0 GHz frequency bands.

translations.source: Nke a ga-enye ya ohere ka dịrị na ndakọta nlaghachi azụ na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, ma ọ bụrụhaala na isi ebe ahụ ụgbọigwe na-anọ nwere redìò abụọ.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This device is compatible with the 802.11a, 802.11b, and 802.11g wireless standards, provided that the device in question has two antennas.

translations.source: Na 802.11n, ọsịsọ ya ji nnukwu ihe kara nke ndị bu ya ụzọ; ya mere, ọrụ ọ na-arụpụta ga-eru 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard uses a wider channel width than its predecessors, allowing it to achieve data transfer rates of up to 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duval, bụ onye lụgoro nwanyị ma mụta ụmụ abụọ bụgoro okenye, a hapụghịrị Mila onyere akọọrọ akụkọ nnukwu ihe nlere anya.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duval, a successful businesswoman and mother of two, was known for her insightful and engaging storytelling.

translations.source: Mgbe a sị ya kwuo okwu gbasara ihe mere, Mila kwuru, "Mike na-ekwu ọtụtụ okwu mgbe a na-eme ọnụnụ ahụ...anọ m na-akwado ya mere na anụghị m ihe ọ na-ekwu."
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When he started talking about what was happening, Mila said, "Mike was saying a lot of things during the argument...and I agreed with him, but I didn't understand what he was saying."

translations.source: Anyị ga-agba mbọ belata ikuku kabon dioxide kwa nke Mkpokọta ihe nrụpụta obodo site na oke 2020 site n'ọkwa 2005, Hu kwuru.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: "We will reduce carbon dioxide emissions from the city's industrial sector by 20% by 2020, compared to the 2005 level," Hu stated.

translations.source: O kwughi oke a ga-akwụ, kama ọ sị na a ga-ele anya na nrụpụta akụ na ụba China wee kwụọ ụgwọ.
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: The speaker stated that there would be a fee for importing goods from China, specifically for electronic products.

translations.source: Hu gbara obodo ndị na emepe emepe ume "ka ha ghara itinye aka n'usoro omume mgbe ochie bụ ibu ụzọ metọọ were kpochawa ma emechaa."
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: The people of the island have a unique tradition of building houses that are designed to withstand the strong winds and storms that frequently occur in their area.

They also received recognition for their efforts to educate the public about the dangers of cybercrime and how to protect themselves.

translations.source: N'agbanyeghị na ọ dị ka ndị na emegide ha bụ ndị ndịda ka ha mma, ndị mba Sawụt Afrịka melitere nwayọ nwayọ ka ịsọ mpi gara n'ihu.
translations.reference: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the fact that some people may perceive them as being less sophisticated than their European counterparts, African immigrants have made significant progress in their lives.

translations.source: Ụzọ mkpachapụ anya ha n’ime mgbochi, ka ha si ejide bọọlụ ma ụzọ nhàzi pụrụ iche mere ha ka ha pụọ iche ma o doro ha anya n’òtù a bụ òtù ha ga-emeri.
translations.reference: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.hypothesis: The team members strategized during the game, focusing on passing the ball and creating scoring opportunities. They worked together to develop a game plan that would give them an advantage and ultimately lead to victory.

translations.source: Ndị ọrụ maka obodo nke Amstardam na Ebe ngosi ihe ndị mgbe ochie Anne Frank na-ekwu na osisi ahụ ebutela ọrịa n’iji ero ma dịkwa njọ makka ahụike ọha dịka ha na-agbagha na ọ nọbụrụ n’ezigbo ihe ize ndụ nke ịdapụga n’ofe.
translations.reference: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.hypothesis: The workers in the Amsterdam city hall and the exhibition hall dedicated to Anne Frank's life reported that the building was suffering from a serious mold problem, with visible signs of decay and a significant impact on the overall health and safety of the building.

translations.source: Akara ya maka mgbututu n'ụbọchị Tuzde, mana azọpụtara ya ka ụlọ ikpe kpegharịrị ikpe na mberede.
translations.reference: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.hypothesis: The event was scheduled for Tuesday, but it was postponed due to the closure of the courthouse.

translations.source: Ụzọ niile dị n'ọgba ahụ a kpọrọ “Ụmụnne nwanyị asaa” dị ihe dịka opekatampe 100 mita ruo mita 250 (fiiti 328 ruo 820) na dayamita.
translations.reference: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.hypothesis: The entire path in this section, referred to as "The Eight Women," stretches approximately 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in length and has a diameter of about 328 to 820 millimeters.

translations.source: Ụmụ onyinyo infràreèd na-egosipụta na mgbanwe okpomọkụ ahụ sitere n'ụbọchị na abalị na-egosi na ha nwere ike ịbụ ọgba.
translations.reference: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.hypothesis: Infrared images show that changes in temperature throughout the day and night suggest that there may be a source of heat.

translations.source: Ha na-adị oyi karịa gburugburu ha n'ehihie ma dị ọkụ karịa n'abalị.
translations.reference: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.hypothesis: They are much more comfortable in the open air than in a confined space, and they are also more active outdoors than indoors.

translations.source: Omume okpomọkụ ha anaghị adịgide ka nnukwu ọgba dị n'ụwa nke na-enwe okpomọkụ na-anaghị agbanwe, mana ọ dị ka ndị a maka na ha bụkwa olulu miri emi n'ime ala," Glen Cushing kwuru, onye United States Geology Survey (USGS) Otu Astrojiọlọji na nke Mahadum Northern Arizona dị na Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: These unusual formations are not like any other large geological structures found around the world, but rather appear to be unique formations within the local area," said Glen Cushing, a geologist from the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: Na mba Frans, ịtụ ụtụ bụ ihe anaghị eji ike eme: ndị na-atụ ụtụ na ewezuga onwe ha n'otu ụlọ ndo, tinye akwụkwọ ebiri na ndịnihu nke na-egosi onye ha na atụrụ ụtụ n'ime akwụkwọ amachiri amachi.
translations.reference: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.hypothesis: In France, the practice of tattooing is not widely accepted: individuals who choose to get tattoos often do so in private, and may conceal their tattoos with clothing or other means to hide them from others.

translations.source: Ka ndị nchịkọta nyochachara onye na-atụ ụtụ, onye na-atụ ụtụ etinye akwụkwọ ụtụ ya amachiri amachi n'ime igbe nnakọ ụtụ ma bie aka n'akwụkwọ ndị tụrụ ụtụ.
translations.reference: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.hypothesis: The interviewers should first identify the person being interviewed, then have them sit down at a desk and place their notes in front of them.

translations.source: Iwu gbasara ntuliaka na Frans depụtara usoro ikpe kpọmkwem.
translations.reference: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.hypothesis: The law regarding the use of firearms was clearly outlined by the French authorities.

translations.source: Kemgbe 1988, ụmụ igbe ntuli aka ga-abụrịrị ngafe-ahụ-ụzọ ka ndị ntụli aka na ndị nnyota ga-agba akaebe na o nweghị envelopu nọ na ya mgbe a na-ebido ntuli aka nakwa o nweghị envelopu etinyere ewezụga nke ndị agụgwere ọnụ ma nye ikikere nke ọma.
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1988, the practice of giving gifts has become increasingly impersonal, with recipients often receiving gifts in envelopes without any personalized note or card.

translations.source: Ndị a na atụrụ ụtụ nwere ike iziga ndị nnọchiteanya ka ha gbaa ama ihe nile mere. Na mgbede, ndị ọrụ efu ga agụkọ ụtụ nile na oke nlegideanya , ma site n'usoro atọrọ atọ.
translations.reference: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.hypothesis: These types of complaints can lead to dissatisfaction among employees. In particular, employees may feel undervalued and unsupported, leading to decreased morale and productivity.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, ewepụtara ụwa niile na mbụ maka ụmụ ihe nchekwa-ego na arụmọrụ ya, wụrụ isiokwu na-ewu ewu n’Ọnwa IT Taipei 2007.
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.hypothesis: The ASUS Eee PC, which was first introduced to the world for its portability and performance, made a splash at the IT Taipei 2007 trade show.

translations.source: Mana ogugo ahịa kọmpụta laptop ga-agbanwe ma dị iche ri nne ka ASUS nwetachara Nturu ugo Taịwan Sọstenebụl Awọdụ n'afọ 2007 site n'aka Ezekutiv Yuan si na Repọblik Chaịna.
translations.reference: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.hypothesis: However, the market for computer laptops has changed significantly since ASUS acquired the Taiwan-based Acer in 2007 from the Taiwanese government.

translations.source: Webụsaịtị steshọn a kpọrọ ihe ngosi a "ihe ngosi redio ndị mgbe ochie nke osote ya ọhụrụ gbasara ịgba ara akwụkwọ ma dị egwu!"
translations.reference: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.hypothesis: This website features an exhibition titled "Old Radio Broadcasts: A Nostalgic Look at the Early Days of Radio Broadcasting and its Impact on Society!"

translations.source: N’oge mbu ya, ihe ngosi a ka egosiputara n’igwe saịtị intaneti na-agba ọsọ nke TogiNet Radio, ebe a lekwasịrị anya na redio na-ekwu okwu.
translations.reference: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the advertisements displayed on the fast-paced TogiNet Radio website focused on spoken word radio programs.

translations.source: N'ọgwụgwụ afọ 2015, TogiNet bidoro AstroNet Redio dị ka mpaghara nọ n'okpuru ya.
translations.reference: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.hypothesis: In 2015, TogiNet acquired AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary.

translations.source: Na mbụ, ihe nkiri ahụ gosipụtara ndị omee olu ka bidoro ebido, ndị si n'ọwụwa anyanwụ Tegzas.
translations.reference: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the film depicted the characters as being deeply involved in the events surrounding the Tegzas incident.

translations.source: A sị na ozuzu ohi gara n'ihu ogologo abalị niile, n'ihi na ndị ọrụ mmanye iwu anọghị n'okporo ama Bishkek.
translations.reference: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.hypothesis: The long-standing conflict in Bishkek has continued for many years, as the authorities have failed to resolve the underlying issues.

translations.source: Otu onye nkere anya kọwapụtara Bishkek dịka ihe na-emikpu n'ọnọdụ "ọgba aghara", ka ndị mmadụ na akpagharị na eburughara ngwa ahịa n'ike.
translations.reference: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.hypothesis: One eyewitness reported that a man in Bishkek was seen acting suspiciously in the area designated as a "restricted zone," leading to concerns about potential illegal activities.

translations.source: Otutu ndi bi na Bishkek tara ndi na-eme ngaghari iwe si na odida anyanwu uta gbasara imebi iwu
translations.reference: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.hypothesis: The number of people in Bishkek who are involved in illegal activities, such as drug trafficking, is significant and poses a serious threat to public safety.

translations.source: Mba Sawụtụ Afrịka emeriela Ọl Bụlaksị (Nuu Ziilandị) n'egwuregwu rọgụbi nke Mbanaatọ n'ama egwuregwu Royal Bafokeng nke dị na Rọstenbọgụ, Sawụtụ Afrịka.
translations.reference: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: Manchester United defeated Royal Bafokeng Stars in a thrilling match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.

translations.source: N'ikpeazụ, otu ọkpụ ka ha jiri merie ha, ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ na otu ebe ndị mmegide ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ. Nke a usoro mmeri iri na ise ndị Ọl Blaks na mmechi.
translations.reference: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.hypothesis: In the end, the Black Stars emerged victorious, winning the match 2-1. This victory marked the 15th time the Black Stars have won the championship.

translations.source: Maka òtù Springboks ndị ahụ, ọ kwụsịrị na egwuregwu-ise nke ogologo usoro ọdịda.
translations.reference: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the Springboks' strong performance, the match ended in a draw, marking the end of a long and intense rivalry.

translations.source: Ọ bụ ịsọmpi ikpeazụ nke Ọl Blaks ndị merigoro ihe nnweta izu ụka abụọ gara aga.
translations.reference: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.hypothesis: It was the final race of the Black Oaks competition, which had been running for two weeks.

translations.source: A ga-agba egwuregwu ikpeazụ nke ogbe a n'Elis Pak na Johanesbọg n'izu na-abịa abịa, mgbe ndị Sprịngbọks ga-agba Ọstrelia.
translations.reference: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The upcoming football match between Elis and Johannesburg will be a major event, as the Springboks will be competing against Australia.

translations.source: Ala ọma jijiji dị larịị mara ọdịda anyanwụ Montana jijiji mgba ojiri nkeji asatọ gafee elekere nke iri n'abalị Monde.
translations.reference: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.hypothesis: The beautiful, snow-capped mountains of Montana, with their towering peaks that reach into the sky, are a breathtaking sight.

translations.source: Mpaghara mba Yunaịted Steeti na-ahụ maka mmegharị ala (USGS) na mpaghara nke na-ezite ozi gbasara ala ọma jijiji enwetabeghị mkpesa ihe mmebi.
translations.reference: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Geological Survey (USGS) is responsible for mapping and monitoring land in the area, and it provides information about the geology and natural resources that are not yet fully understood.

translations.source: Ala ọma jijiji ahụ nwere etiti ya na ihe dị ka km 20 (maịlị 15) ugwu-ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụnke Dillon, na ihe dị ka km 65 (maịlị 40) ndịda nke Butte.
translations.reference: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.hypothesis: The scenic valley has a length of approximately 20 kilometers (12 miles) along the eastern slope of the Dillon mountain range, and another approximately 65 kilometers (40 miles) along the western slope of the Butte range.

translations.source: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, n'ala mpịtọ dị Lyon nso nke dị n'ọwụwa anyanwụ mba Frans, ka achọpụtara na ọrịa gburu otu ọbọgwụ bụ ụdịrị ọrịa nnụnụ nke nwere ike igbu mmadụ, bụ H5N1.
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, in a poultry farm in the western region of France, a highly contagious and deadly strain of avian influenza, known as H5N1, was discovered.

translations.source: Frans bụ mba nke asaa n'ọgbakọ Iroopu ịta ahụhụ n'ihi ọrịa a; osotere Ọstrịa, Jemani, Slovenia, Bọlgeria, Gris na Itali.
translations.reference: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.hypothesis: France is a country in Western Europe, bordering Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece, and Italy.

translations.source: Enwere orịa a ka na-enyo enyo ka ọ bụ H5N1na mba Kroeshia na Denmak.
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.hypothesis: There have been cases of this H5N1 virus in both Croatia and Denmark.

translations.source: Chambers gbara Chukwu akwụkwọ maka "ọnwụ zuru ebe niile, mmebi na iyi egwu eyiri nde ka nde mmadụ bi n’ụwa."
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers wrote a book titled "Death Everywhere, Suffering and the Joy of Living"

translations.source: Chambers, onye na-ajụkarị oge niile, na-agbagha na ikpe ya "abaghị uru" ma "onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịkụ onye ọbụla ikpe."
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, who was known for his frequent complaints and accusations, vehemently denied the charges, stating that "there was no evidence" and that "anyone could be falsely accused."

translations.source: Akụkọ egosipụtara na opera french, nke Camille Saint-Saens dere, bụ maka onye na-ese ihe "nke ịhụnanya o nwere maka Japan na ọgwụ ike na-achị ndụ ya."
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.hypothesis: The story revealed that the French opera, written by Camille Saint-Saens, was a tribute to "the love he had for Japan and his fascination with its martial arts and healing practices."

translations.source: N'ihi nke a ndị na-eme ihe ngosi na-ese igbo n'ebe ngosi ihe, ndị nwe ụlọ ngosi ihe na-akwadokwa ndị nlere anya ka ha sonye.
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, art galleries are increasingly using digital displays to showcase artwork, and gallery owners are also encouraging visitors to use their own devices to view the exhibits.

translations.source: Onye na-ekwubu okwu n'ụlọ omeiwu bụ Newt Gingrich, onye isi obodo Tekzas bụ Rik Perị, na onye otu nzukọ omeiwu Mishel Bakmann mechara gba ndị anọ, ise na isii, n'usoro.
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.hypothesis: The four candidates who participated in the debate were Newt Gingrich, the former Speaker of the House; Rick Perry, the Governor of Texas; and Michele Bachmann, a member of Congress.

translations.source: Ka akara omume pụtara, Gingrich kelere Santorum, mana ọ gwara Rọmni okwu ike, n'ihi ụdịrị mkpọsa ozi ọ kpọsara megide Gringrich na Ayowa.
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: As the debate progressed, Gingrich defeated Santorum, but he still managed to sway some voters, particularly in the swing states of Florida and Ohio.

translations.source: Perry kwuru na ọ ga "agaghachị Tekzas ileba anya n'akara omume abalị a, ịchọpụta ma o nwere ọganihu n'ọsọ ahụ", ma na omechara kwuo na ọ ga anọgide n'ọsọ ma sọọ mpi izizi na Karolaina n'ụbọchị nke iri abụọ na otu nke ọnwa Jenụwarị.
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: Perry stated that "Texas will not be able to fully assess the impact of this storm, and it is likely to remain a significant threat for several days." However, he also cautioned that the storm could intensify and bring heavy rain to the Dallas-Fort Worth area on the second day of January.

translations.source: Bakman, onye meriri Ntuliaka Ames Strọ n'Ọgọọst, kpebiri ịkwụsị kampen ya.
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.hypothesis: Bakman, the owner of the "Ntuliaka Ames Street" store, decided to close his business.

translations.source: E bugara onye ahụ na-ese fòto na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Reagan UCLA, ebe o mechara nwụọ.
translations.reference: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.hypothesis: The man was found unconscious in the Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he had been taken.

translations.source: A kọbụrụ na ọ nọ n’ime ụmụ afọiri abụọ ya. N’otu nkwupụta, Bieber siri "Agbanyeghị na ọ nọghị ma ọ sonyeghị ozugbo ọdachi ihe mberede okporo ụzọ a, echiche na ekpere m nonyere ezinụlọ ndị onye a tara ahụhụ."
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.hypothesis: He was about two years old. In one instance, Bieber was seen "running and not stopping until he reached the end of the street, then he realized that he had forgotten to pick up his mother."

translations.source: Webụsaịtị akụkọ ntụrụndụ TMZ ghọtara onye na-ese fòto ahụ kwụsịrị ụgbọala ya n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke okporo ámá Sepulveda sara mbara nwere ụmụ osisi akwụwara n'akụkụ ya ma nwaa ị see fòto nkwụsị ndị uwe ojii tupu ya agafee okporo ụzọ wee gaa n'ihu, na-akpali onye uwe ojii Njeghari ilekota Nnukwu okporo ụzọ anya nke California na-eduzi okporo ụzọ iji nyeghachi ya iwu gafeghachị , ugboro abụọ.
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.hypothesis: The TMZ entertainment website reported that a man was arrested for blocking traffic on the Sepulveda Freeway after he pulled over to take a photo of a tree with unusual-looking branches. The man, identified as Njeghari, was reportedly driving a black sedan when he pulled over to the side of the road to take a picture of the tree before continuing on his way.

translations.source: Dị ka ndị uwe ojii kwuru, ọkwụ ụgbọ ala ahụ suru onye na-ese fòto eleghị anya ọ gaghị enwe ebubo mpụ ọ bụla.
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.hypothesis: As one of the black artists stated, the sculpture is so realistic that it appears to have no flaws.

translations.source: Ya na naanị medaal iri na asatọ dị kwa otu ụbọchị, ọtụtụ mba adala imepụta ikpo okwu medaal ahụ.
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.hypothesis: Only six medals were awarded each day, with many countries competing for the coveted prize.

translations.source: Ha gụnyere mba Nedalands, ebe Anna Jochemsen gbara onye nke itoolu n'egwuregwu nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwanyị nke asọmpi Super-G ụnyaahụ, na Fịnland ebe Katja Saarinen gbara onye nke iri n'otu egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.hypothesis: Anna Jochemsen of the Netherlands won the gold medal in the women's Super-G race at the World Championships in Finland, while Katja Saarinen of Finland finished in third place.

translations.source: Michel Gọrli gbachara Super-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke dịka onye nke iri na otu. Oldrich Jelinek, onye Chek rịpọblik gbara onye nke iri na isii na Super-G ọnụnọ ala ụmụ nwoke.
