translations.hypothesis: These trees are not mangrove trees – they are actually trees that have grown from seeds carried by the wind from mangrove forests in the Ganjiz area.

translations.source: Sundabans kpuchiri ohere km² 3850, nke mmiri maọbụ ala apịtị kpuchiri otu ụzọ n'ụzọ atọ ya.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.hypothesis: Sundabans covers an area of 3850 square kilometers, with approximately three-quarters of the land being covered by water.

translations.source: Ka mgbe 1966, ka Sundarbans ji buru ebe obibi nso anu ohia ana asi na aga enwe ihe dika 400 Royal Bengal tiger na ihe dika 30,000 mgbada nwere ntupo na mpaghara ebe ahu.
translations.reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1960s, the Sundarbans mangrove forest was home to a large population of tigers and other wildlife, including an estimated 400 Royal Bengal tigers and 30,000 spotted deer.

translations.source: Bọọsụ na-esi n'ọdụ ụgbọala njikọ-mpaghara apụ (n'ofe osimiri ahụ) mgbe niile n'ụbọchị, agbanyeghị na nke kacha, tụmadị ndị ahụ na-aga n'ebe ọwụwaanyanwụ na Jakar/Bumthang na-apụ n'etiti 06:30 na 07:30.
translations.reference: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Buses regularly depart from the local bus station (on the riverbank) every day, with the most frequent departures being those heading to Jakar/Bumthang, which leave between 06:30 and 07:30.

translations.source: Dị ka ụmụ bọọsụ njikọ-mpaghara na-ejukarị eju, ọ bụ ezi ndụmọdụ ịzụta otu tiketi ụbọchị ole na ole n'ọdịnihu.
translations.reference: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.hypothesis: Like train tickets for local travel, it is advisable to purchase tickets in advance for future trips.

translations.source: A na-ejere imirikiti mpaghara ozi site n'ụmụ Nnukwu Bọọsụ nke ndị Japan, nke dị mma ma sie ike.
translations.reference: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.hypothesis: It is a large, impressive structure, similar to the Great Hall of the Japanese Imperial Palace, and is very well-maintained.

translations.source: Tagzi ekere eke bụ ụzọ dị ọsịsọ ma maa mma iji gaa ebe dị nso, dịka Paro (Nu 150) na Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.reference: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: The Tagzi trek is a challenging but rewarding route to reach nearby destinations, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).

translations.source: Akwammiri Osimiri Oyapock bụ otu akwa mmiri ejiri kebùl runye ya. Ọ gbara gburugburu Osimiri Oyapock iji jikọọ ụmụ obodo nke Oiapoque n'ime Brazịl na Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock n'ime French Guiana.
translations.reference: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.hypothesis: The Akwammiri Osimiri Oyapock is a navigable river that connects the communities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.

translations.source: Towa abuo ahu rigoro 83 meters, ogologo o bu 378 meters n’ogologo ma o nwekwara obodobo uzo abuo di 3.50m.
translations.reference: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.hypothesis: The tower is 83 meters high, with a base that is 378 meters in circumference and a diameter of 3.50 meters.

translations.source: Ogologo ahụ ya kwụ-ọtọ nke akwa mmiri ahụ bụ mita 15. A rụchara ọrụrụ ya n'Ọgọọst 2011, e mepeghị ya nye ụgbọala ruo Maachị 2017.
translations.reference: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.hypothesis: The length of the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, and it was officially opened to traffic in March 2017.

translations.source: E hiwere na akwa ahụ ga-ebido rụwa ọrụ n'uju na Septemba 2017, mgbe a na-ele anya ịrụcha ebe nnyocha nke ụlọọrụ na-ahụ maka ọpụpụ na mbata nke ndị Brazili.
translations.reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.hypothesis: The agreement was signed on September 2017, following discussions between Brazilian authorities and representatives of the international organization responsible for investigating and preventing illegal logging.

translations.source: Ndị Guaraní bụ otu amaala kachasị gbaa ọkpụrụkpụrụ bi n'eba a na-akpọ ugbua Ọwụwaanyanwụ Paragụwa, ha na-ebi ka ndị dinta na-awagharị awagharị ma na-arụkwa ọrụ ugbo mmepụta nri nke onwe.
translations.reference: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.hypothesis: The Guarani are an indigenous people of Paraguay, known for their traditional farming practices and their self-sufficient lifestyle.

translations.source: Mpaghara Chako bụ ụlọ nye ụfọdụ agbụrụ amaala ndị ọzọ dịka Guaykuru na Payagua, ndị ji nta, ntụtụkọ, na ịkụ azụ wee zụọ onwe ha nri.
translations.reference: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.hypothesis: The Mpaghara Chako is a community center that serves various indigenous groups, including the Guaykurú and Payagua, providing spaces for meetings, workshops, and self-sufficiency training.

translations.source: N'ime narị afọ nke iri na isii Paragwei, a kpọbụrụ "Nnukwu Ngalaba Ọchịchị nke Ndị Indii", bụ nke a mụrụ n'ihi mbịakwute nke ndị mmeri Ndị Spen ya na ụmụ òtù nwaafọ amaala.
translations.reference: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1966 Nigerian Civil War, a period known as the "Nigerian Independence Crisis," which was triggered by the coup of the then-ruling military government.

translations.source: Ndị Spen bidoro oge ọchịchị ike nke digidere ruo narị afọ atọ.
translations.reference: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The Spen dynasty ruled for three decades of absolute power.

translations.source: Kemgbe ntọala Asunción n’ime 1537, Paraguay agbalịala idobe ọtụtụ n’ime omume na njirimara amaala ya.
translations.reference: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.hypothesis: Since the founding of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has developed a unique set of customs and traditions.

translations.source: Amaara mba Ajentịna dịka obodo nwere ndị egwuregwu na otu egwuregwu polo kachasị mma n'ụwa dum.
translations.reference: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.hypothesis: Ajentina is a country known for its passionate football culture and its world-class football team.

translations.source: Ndọrọndọrọ kachasị ukwu nke afọ ahụ na-eme na Disemba na fịịldị polo n’ime Las Cañitas.
translations.reference: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.hypothesis: The most significant event of the year took place in December, with a large gathering in Las Cañitas.

translations.source: Obere asọmpi ga na egwuregwu bọlụ ga ka e nwere ike ịhụ ebe a n'oge ụfọdụ n'afọ.
translations.reference: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.hypothesis: The annual football tournament will feature matches that can be seen at various times throughout the year.

translations.source: Maka akụkọ gbasara ụmụ ndorondoro na ebe a na-azụ tiketi maka egwuregwu polo, lelee Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.reference: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.hypothesis: For news about polo and where to buy tickets for polo matches, please visit the Argentine Polo Association.

translations.source: Ego azụmahịa mba Fọlkụlandị bụ pam Fọlkụlandị (FKP) nke ọnụ ya na otu pam ndị Britenị (GBP) ha.
translations.reference: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: The business currency of the Falkland Islands is the Falkland Island Pound (FKP), which is pegged to the British Pound (GBP).

translations.source: E nere ike ime mgbanwe ego na naanị otu ụlọ akụ nọ n’agwaetiti ndị ahụ nke a ga-achọtali n’ime Stanley n’ofe site n’ụlọ ahịa FIC West.
translations.reference: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.hypothesis: There is only one bank branch in that area, which is located in Stanley, and it is part of the FIC West network.

translations.source: A ga-anabata n’izugbe pam ndị Britenụ ebe ọbụla n’ime agwaetiti ndị ahụ ma na gburugburu ụmụ kaadị mbiri ego Stanley na dọla mba Amerịka sokwa na ndị a na-anabata.
translations.reference: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.hypothesis: The British government has banned the use of the Stanley and Dollar currencies in all parts of the country, and anyone found using them will be prosecuted.

translations.source: N’agwaetiti ndị nọ na mpụga ebe ahụ ụmụ kaadị akwụmụgwọ nwere ike a gaghị anabata ya, n’agbanyeghị na enwere ike iwe ego Britenụ na United States; leru anya na ndị nwe ya n’ọdịnihu iji chọpụta ihe bụ ụzọ nkwụmụgwọ a na-anabata.
translations.reference: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.hypothesis: In areas where these educational cards are not readily available, despite the presence of British and American currency, it is important to seek out alternative methods of education.

translations.source: Ọ na-ara ezigbote ahụ ịgbanwe ego Falklands ma e si n'agwaetiti a pụọ, ya mere gbanwee ego gi tupu i si na ya pụọ.
translations.reference: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.hypothesis: He was planning to exchange the Falkland Islands currency for the local currency, so he asked me to exchange mine before he left.

translations.source: Ebe Montevideo dị na ndịda Iquetọ, ọ bụ oge ọkọchị ebe ahụ mgbe oge oyi dị na Ebe ugwu Emisfee ma n'otu aka ahụ.
translations.reference: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.hypothesis: Located in the Montevideo area of Uruguay, this is a pleasant place to visit during the summer months, when the weather is warm and sunny.

translations.source: Montevideo nọ n'ime ebe na-ekpọ ọkụ ma jụọkwa oyi; n'ime ụmụ ọnwa ọkọchị, okpomọkụ gafere +30°C bụ ihe nkịtị.
translations.reference: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo is located in a warm climate, with average temperatures of around +30°C during the summer months.

translations.source: Oge oyi nwere ike ịjụ ezigbo oyi n'aghụghọ: okpomọkụ na-ara ahụ tupu ya gaa n'okpuru ịghọ okwute mmiri, mana ikuku na oruru mmiri na-abịakọta ọnụ ime ka o nwee mmetụta kara jụọ oyi karịa ihe temometa kwuru.
translations.reference: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
translations.hypothesis: The process of evaporation can be quite fascinating to observe: as the sun heats the surface of a body of water, the water molecules begin to vibrate and eventually break free from the liquid state, rising into the air as water vapor. However, the presence of wind and humidity can significantly affect the rate of evaporation, making it faster than what would be expected based on the temperature alone.

translations.source: Enweghị ihe dị ka "udu mmiri" na "ọkọchị": ogo mmiri ozuzo na-anọkarị otu ebe ogologo afọ niile.
translations.reference: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
translations.hypothesis: There is no such thing as "water level" or "flood season": the water level remains relatively constant throughout the year.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị na ọ maala ahụ ọtụtụ n'ime ụmụ anụmanụ nọ n'obianụmanụ ịhụ ndị mmadụ, ka o sina dị anụ ọhịa bụ nke azụghịazụ ma e kwesịghị inye ha nri ma ọ bụ nye ha nsogbu.
translations.reference: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
translations.hypothesis: It is important to remember that many animals in the wild are not domesticated and should not be approached or fed, as they may be dangerous and could carry diseases.

translations.source: Site n'aka ndị na-ahụ maka ogige anụmanụ, nọtee aka opekata mpe yadị maọbụ mita 100 n'ebe anụ ọhịa bea na wulfu nọ na yadị maọbụ mita 25 n'ebe anụ ọhịa ndị ọzọ niile nọ!
translations.reference: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.hypothesis: The areas where vultures and other scavenging birds are commonly found typically range from approximately 100 to 25 meters in diameter, covering open areas such as grasslands and savannas.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị etu ha siri dị nwayọọ, bison, elk, muuz, bea, na anụmanụ ukwu niile nwere ike iluso ọgụ.
translations.reference: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.hypothesis: Although these animals are generally peaceful, bison, elk, moose, deer, and other large mammals can pose a threat.

translations.source: Afọ ọ bụla, a na-emerụ ọtụtụ ndị nleta ahụ n'ihi na ha enyeghị ezigbo ohere. Ụmụ anụmanụ ndị a buru ibu, azụghịazụ, ma nweekkwa ike ịbụ ihe ize ndụ, ya mere nye ha ohere.
translations.reference: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.hypothesis: Each year, many elderly people are excluded from participating due to a lack of opportunities. These individuals, who are often frail, have limited mobility, and are vulnerable to health problems, are therefore unable to fully engage.

translations.source: Na mgbakwunye, mara amara na usi na adọta ụmụ bea na anụ ọhịa ndị ọzọ, ya mere zere ibu ma ọ bụ isi ụmụ nri na-esi usi ma debe kampụ dị ọcha.
translations.reference: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
translations.hypothesis: In addition, it is important to note that the use of plastic and other non-biodegradable materials can harm wildlife and the environment, so it is best to avoid using them whenever possible.

translations.source: Apia bụ isi obodo Samoa. Obodo ahụ nọ n'agwaetiti Upolu ma ma nwee ngụpụta mmadụ nke ji obere ihe ghara eru 40,000.
translations.reference: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
translations.hypothesis: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The country is located in the South Pacific and has a population of approximately 40,000 people.

translations.source: E kepụtara Apịa n'afọ ndị 1850; kemgbe 1959, ọ bụ isi obodo Samoa.
translations.reference: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Apịa was founded in the 1850s; since 1959, it has been the capital of Samoa.

translations.source: Ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ahụ bụ ebe nguzosike nke ndị agha mmiri wuru ewu na 1889 mgbe nnukwu ụgbọ mmiri asaa si Jamani, US, na Briten jụrụ ịhapụ ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ahụ.
translations.reference: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
translations.hypothesis: The canal was a strategic point for the British military, as it was seized by German, American, and British forces in 1889 during the capture of the canal.

translations.source: Nnukwu ụgbọ mmiri niile ndị ahụ miri, ewezụga otu ụgbọ agha Ndị Briten. Ọ fọrọ obere ka o ruo Ndị Amerịka na Ndị Jamani 200 nwụrụnụ.
translations.reference: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
translations.hypothesis: The large ship was heavily armed, and it was used by the British to transport troops to America and Germany during World War II. It sank in 2007.

translations.source: N'oge mgba maka nnwereonwe nke a haziri site n'aka ngagharị Mau, otu nzukọ keudo n'ime obodo rụpụtara n'ogbugbu nke ezigbo onyeisi Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.reference: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.hypothesis: During the construction of this building, which is located in the city of Mau, a significant event occurred: the passing away of the esteemed Chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

translations.source: E nwere ọtụtụ ọnụ mmiri, n’ihi nnọnetiti nke Ọklandị nke ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri abụọ. Ndị nke kacha ewu ewu nọ n’ebe atọ.
translations.reference: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
translations.hypothesis: There were several canals, due to the uneven terrain of the area. The three most prominent ones were located in three different places.

translations.source: Akụkụ mmiri Ọnụmmiri Ugwu (nọ na mpaghara Ugwu Ebe ndote ụgbọ mmiri) nọ n’oke osimiri Pacifik ma dọtịa site na Long Bay nọ n’ugwu ruo Devonport nọ na ndịda.
translations.reference: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.hypothesis: The Akụkụ mmiri Ọnụmmiri Ugwu (located in the area of Mount Wellington, near the Parramatta River) stretches from Long Bay in the west to Devonport in the east.

translations.source: Ha niile fọrọ obere ka ha bụrụchaa akụkụ mmiri aja aja ya na igwu mmiri echedoro echedo, ma ọtụtụ n'ime ha nwere ndo enyere site n'aka ụmụ osisi pohutukawa.
translations.reference: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.hypothesis: These small, delicate flowers are a beautiful addition to any water garden, and many of them are native to the Pacific Northwest.

translations.source: Ụmụ akụkụ mmiri Tamaki Drive nọ n’Ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri Waitemata ahụ, n’ime ahịa ndị bara ụba nọ mpaghara ebe obibi nke Mission Bay na St Heliers n’ime Central Auckland.
translations.reference: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.hypothesis: The water features of Tamaki Drive are located on the Waitemata Harbour, within the bustling waterfront area between Mission Bay and St Heliers in central Auckland.

translations.source: Ebe ndị a bụ mgbe ụfọdụ akụkụ mmiri ezinụlọ ndị mmadụ juru ya n’ọtụtụ ụdị ụlọ ahịa nọ n’ogologo ọnụ mmiri ahụ. Igwu mmiri dị mma.
translations.reference: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.hypothesis: These are some common types of water features found in homes, ranging from small fountains to elaborate indoor waterfalls. The water features are aesthetically pleasing.

translations.source: Isi biya imeobodo ahụ bụ 'Number One', ọ bụghị biya na-agbagwoju anya, mana dị mma n'ahụ ma na-edo ahụ nke ọma. Biya imeobodo nke ọzọ bụ nke a na-akpọ "Manta".
translations.reference: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.hypothesis: The first type of shoe is called "Number One," but it is not a particularly stylish shoe. The second type of shoe is called "Manta."

translations.source: Enwere ọtụtụ mmanya si Frans mmadụ ga-aṅụ, mana mmanya Niu Ziland na Ọstrelia ga-aka mma maka njem.
translations.reference: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.hypothesis: There are many different types of beer available, but the beers from France and Belgium are particularly good for drinking.

translations.source: Mmiri mgbata ebeụlọ dị mma nke ọma ịn̄ụ, mana mmiri bọtụlụ dị mfe ịchọta ma ọ bụrụ na ụjọ na-atụ gị.
translations.reference: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.hypothesis: The tap water is generally safe to drink, but bottled water is readily available if you prefer.

translations.source: Maka ndị Australia, kọfị 'flat white' bụ ihe ala ọzọ. Shọt blak bụ 'espresso', cappuccino na-ebu nnukwu krim abịa (ọ bụghị froth), ha na-añụ tii na-etinyeghị mmiri ara ehi.
translations.reference: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.hypothesis: For Australians, "flat white" is a different kind of coffee. A "flat white" is made with espresso and a thin layer of steamed milk, unlike a cappuccino, which has a thicker layer of foam.

translations.source: Chokoleeti ọkụ a ruru ogo nke Beljiọm. Mmanya mkpụrụ osisi dị ọnụ mana ha amaka.
translations.reference: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.hypothesis: The cocoa beans are harvested in large quantities. The beans are of good quality, but they are not yet fully ripe.

translations.source: A na-eme ọtụtụ njem ịga na ime ala osimiri gburugburu afọ niile, ma mmerụ ahụ n'ihi otu n'ime ihe mkpata ndị a n'ime ala osimiri ahụ na-ara ahụ inweta.
translations.reference: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.hypothesis: There are many trips taken to the riverbank throughout the year, but these trips are often disrupted by one of the common hazards found in the river environment.

translations.source: N’agbanyeghị, were ndụmọdụ si n'aka ndị nọ n’ọchịchị, rube isi n’ihe ntụaka niile, ma gee ntị nke ọma maka ịdọ aka na ntị nke nchekwa.
translations.reference: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.hypothesis: However, despite the advice received from those in authority, the focus remained on the core issues, with a strong emphasis on security and safety.

translations.source: Azụjelii igbe na-apụta n'akụkụ ọnụ osimiri ma n'ụso ụmụ njekọta osimiri site n'Ọktoba ruo Eprel ugwu nke 1770. E nwekwara ike ịhụ ha mgbe ụfọdụ n'oge ndị ọzọ n'abụghị oge ndị a.
translations.reference: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.hypothesis: The sandbar extends along the riverbank and into the river, from October to early April of 1770. It can be seen at other times as well, though not during these months.

translations.source: Shaakị gasị dị adị, otú ọ dị, ha adịkarịghị awakpo ụmụ mmadụ. Imirikiti shaakị na-atụ ụmụ mmadụ egwu yana ga-egwu mmiri pụọ.
translations.reference: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.hypothesis: The type of shark varies, but they are generally not aggressive towards humans. Sharks are apex predators and play an important role in the marine ecosystem.

translations.source: Agụiyi mmiri nnu anaghị ebikewe n'ime oke osimiri, ebe ha na-ebikarị bụ na ngwọkọta osimiri na mmiri nnu dị n'ugwu sitere na Rọkhamptịn.
translations.reference: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: The freshwater fish cannot survive in saltwater, as they are adapted to the specific conditions of freshwater rivers and lakes originating from the River Thames.

translations.source: Itinye akwụkwọ n’ọdịnihu na-enye onye njem ahụ obi udo na ha nwere ebe ha ga-arahụ ụra ozugbo ha rutere ebe ha na-aga.
translations.reference: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.hypothesis: The prospect of a future home provides the traveler with a sense of security and the assurance that they will have a place to rest and relax as soon as they arrive.

translations.source: Ndị nnọchi anya ndị njem na-enwekarị nkwekọ azụmahịa ha na kpọmkwem ụmụ họteelụ, agbanyeghị na ị nwere ike ịhụ na o kwere omume itinye akwụkwọ maka ụdị nnabata ndị ọzọ, dị ka ala ebe a na-ama ụlọikwu, sitere n'otu onye nnọchite anya njem.
translations.reference: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agencies often have partnerships with specific hotels, which means you might see promotions or special offers from one agency that are only available at a particular hotel.

translations.source: Ndị nnọchi anya ndị njem na-enyekarị ụmụ ngwungwu na-agụnye nri ụtụtụ, nhazi ụzọ esi eje njem ịga na/site na ọdụ ụgbọelu ma ọ bụ njem ụgbọelu etikọrọ ọnụ ya na ụmụ ngwungwu họteelụ.
translations.reference: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agencies often include amenities such as breakfast, directions for getting to the airport or train station, and information about nearby hotels in their travel packages.

translations.source: Ha nwekwara ike idobere gị ohere a ma ọ bụrụ na ị ka chọrọ oge ịtụgharị uche na ya maọbụ ịnweta akwụkwọ ndị ọzọ maka ebe ị na-aga (ọmụmaatụ: visa).
translations.reference: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.hypothesis: They have the ability to help you with this, whether you need time to reconsider your decision or you require additional documents for your trip (e.g., a visa).

translations.source: Ihe ọbụla a chọrọ ịgbanwe maọbụ ịna, ọ bụ onye ejenti njem ka a ga-ebu ụzọ gakwuru; ọ bụghị họteelụ n'onwe ya.
translations.reference: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.hypothesis: Anything that needs to be changed or improved requires a deliberate and purposeful effort; it cannot simply happen by chance.

translations.source: Maka ụfọdụ mmemme, nnukwu ọtụtụ n’ime ndị bịara na mmemme egwu ahụ kpebiri ịnọ na kampụ n’ebe ahụ, ma ọtụtụ n’ime ndị bịara na-ewe ya otu akụkụ dị oke mkpa nke ahụmihe ahụ.
translations.reference: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.hypothesis: For some events, a large number of attendees chose to remain at the venue, while others were eager to experience a specific aspect of the event.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ịnọ nso na emereme ahụ ị ga-ekwesị ịbanye ọsịịsọ iji nweta otu ebe a na-ama ụlọikwu nọ nso n'egwu ahụ.
translations.reference: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.hypothesis: If you want to participate in the upcoming event, you should register in advance to secure a spot in the venue.

translations.source: Cheta na obu ezie na egwu ogbo-egwu nwere ike gwula, enwere ike inwe mpaghara mmeme ahu gana aku egwu ruo ime abali.
translations.reference: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.hypothesis: It is important to note that while some forms of long-term gambling can be addictive, there are also ways to manage and control these behaviors.

translations.source: Ụfọdụ ememme nwere ebe ndị a na-ama ụlọikwuu pụrụ iche maka ezinụlọ nke nwere ụmụ na-eto eto.
translations.reference: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.hypothesis: Some homes have specific areas designated for children, such as playrooms or nurseries.

translations.source: Mgbe ị na-agafe Ebe ugwu Baltic n’oge oyi, lelee ebe kabịn ahụ, dị ka ịgafe okwute mmiri na-akpata mkpọtụ dị nnọọ egwu maka ndị ọ kacha metụta.
translations.reference: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.hypothesis: When you visit the Baltic Sea in the summer, look for the beaches, where you can enjoy swimming and other water activities.

translations.source: Njem nnyagharị nke Senti Piitasbọg gụnyere oge n'ime obodo. Ndị njem nke njem nnyagharị bụ ndị ewezụgara site n'ụmụ ihe ndị achọrọ maka visa (lelee usoro ahụ).
translations.reference: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.hypothesis: The application process for a Schengen visa includes providing various documents, such as proof of travel plans (e.g., flight itinerary).

translations.source: Ụlọ chaa chaa gasị na-eme ihe niile ịhụ na ndị mmadụ mefuru oge na ego ha niile. Windo na elekere anaghị adịkewe n'ime ha; ọzọ, ụzọ ọpụpụ na-arakarị ahụ ịchọta.
translations.reference: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.hypothesis: The abandoned house was in a state of disrepair, with broken windows and a leaky roof. The overgrown yard was also a hazard, with weeds and debris everywhere.

translations.source: Ha na-enwekarị nri pụrụ iche, mmanya na ụmụ onyinye ntụrụndụ, iji debe ndị ọbịa n'ọnọdụ dị mma, ma debe ha n'ogige ahụ.
translations.reference: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.hypothesis: The establishment offers a variety of unique dishes, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and a range of entertainment options to ensure that guests have a pleasant and memorable experience.

translations.source: Ụfọdụ ebe mgbakọ na-enye ụmụ ihe ọn̄ụn̄ụ na-eme n'anya n'efu. Mana, mmanya ogbugbu na-egbochi echiche, ma ndị nille na-agba chaa chaa nke ọma mara mkpa nke ọ dị ịnọ n'ezi echiche.
translations.reference: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.hypothesis: Some meeting spaces offer free refreshments for attendees. However, alcohol can impair judgment, and it is important for participants to remain alert and focused.

translations.source: Onye ọ bụla nke na-aga ịnya ụgbọ ala ya elu latitude maọbụ n’elu ugwu gafere, kwesịrị ịtụle ihe enwere ike ịbụ oge snow, ice, ma ọ bụ oke oyi.
translations.reference: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone traveling on a high-altitude road or mountain pass should be aware of the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.

translations.source: N’okporo ụzọ ebe ais na sno dị, nrapara dị ala nakwa ịnweghị ike ịnya moto n'elu ya dịka ị nọ na asfalt nkịtị.
translations.reference: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.hypothesis: The road surface was uneven and full of potholes, making it difficult to ride a motorcycle on it as if it were a smooth paved road.

translations.source: N'oge ụmụ oke ozuzo okwute mmiri, sinoo ga-ezu iji mee ka ị tọọ nwere ike izo n'ime ntakịrị oge.
translations.reference: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.hypothesis: When the young plants are still small, it is important to water them regularly to ensure they grow properly.

translations.source: Enwere ike igbochi mgbàràìhè site na ịda ma ọ bụ ịfụ sinoo ma ọ bụ site na umu irighiri mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri kpụkọrọ akpụkọ na windo ụgbọala.
translations.reference: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.hypothesis: I can obtain a flat tire from driving, hitting an object, or from a leak in the tire or wheel.

translations.source: N'aka nke ọzọ, ụmụ ọnọdụ okwute mmiri na sinoo bụ ihe nkịtị n'ọtụtụ mba, ma ụmụ ụgbọala na-anyagharị n'enweghị nsogbu afọ niile.
translations.reference: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.hypothesis: In addition, the use of water and electricity in many countries is still limited, but the availability of reliable power sources is improving.

translations.source: Safari nwere ike ịbụ ihe kachasị akpọta ndị njem nlereanya na Afrịka ma bụrụkwa ihe kachasị atụ ha n'anya.
translations.reference: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.hypothesis: Safaris can be the most exciting and adventurous trips one can take in Africa, or they can simply be a relaxing and enjoyable way to experience the continent.

translations.source: Okwu bụ safari n’ojiji ama ama pụtara ime njem n’ofe ala ileleanụ ọhịa Afrịka dị ịtụnanya, tụnadị na savanna.
translations.reference: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.hypothesis: The word "safari" refers to a journey or expedition, typically into a wild and remote area of Africa, such as the savanna.

translations.source: Ụmụanụmanụ ụfọdụ, dịka enyi ga na mgbara ga, na-abịaru nso n’ụgbọala ma ngwaọrụ izugbe dị mma ga-enye gị ohere iji hụ ha nke ọma.
translations.reference: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.hypothesis: Certain types of musical instruments, such as guitars and pianos, can be easily transported and used in various settings, providing you with the opportunity to enjoy them wherever you go.

translations.source: Ọdụm, agụogbu na agụ na-eme ihere mgbe ụfọdụ ma ị ga-ahụ na nke ọma karịa n'iji baịnokụlaasị.
translations.reference: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, the smell of cooking food can be overpowering, but it can also be a pleasant experience when enjoyed in a comfortable setting.

translations.source: Safari ngagharị (nke a na-akpọkwa "njem ọhịa", "safari ọrịrị", maọbụ "nzọụkwụ") gbakwunyere ịrị ugwu ruo awa ole na ole maọbụ ọtụtụ ụbọchị.
translations.reference: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.hypothesis: The safari trip (also known as "wildlife safari" or "expedition") involved traveling for several hours or days.

translations.source: Engwuregwu Paralimpiks ga-eme site n'Ọgọọst 24 ruo na Septemba 5 2021. A ga-eme ụfọdụ emume n'ebe ndị ọzọ gburugburu Japan.
translations.reference: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.hypothesis: The Paralympic Games will take place from August 24 to September 5, 2021. There will be some related events held in other locations around Japan.

translations.source: Tokyo ga-abụ naanị obodo Eshia nke kwadoro asọmpi nke oge okpomọkụ ugboro abụọ, ebe akwadoro egwuregwu ahụ na 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo is the only Asian city to have hosted the Summer Olympics twice, having hosted the games in 1964.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị kwụrụ ụgwọ maka ụgbọelu gị na ebe obibi gị maka 2020 tupu ekwuputa myigharịrị oge, i nwere ike inwe ọnọdụ tara akpụ.
translations.reference: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.hypothesis: If you paid for your flight and accommodation for 2020 before the pandemic, you may be entitled to a refund.

translations.source: Iwu nkagbu na-adị iche iche, mana ka ọ dị na Maachị gara aga ọtụtụ n'ime ụmụ iwu nkagbu dabere na njecorona agbatịghị ruo Julaị 2020, mgbe ahazirioge Olumpiks ahụ.
translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: The Olympic Games have had different dates over the years, but in the past, many of the games were postponed due to concerns about the spread of the coronavirus, until the 2020 Olympics were held.

translations.source: Ọ bụ ihe atụwara anya ya na ọtụtụ tiketị emume ga-adị ọnụ n'etiti ¥2,500 na ¥130,000, ya na tiketị a na-ahụkarị na-adị ọnụ ruo ihe dị ka ¥7,000.
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: It was surprising to see that the prices of concert tickets ranged from ¥2,500 to ¥130,000, while the most common tickets cost around ¥7,000.

translations.source: Ide akwa butụ mmiri nwere ike inyere ha aka ịkọ. Ọtụtụ ụlọ nkwarị akụ nwere otu igwe ndetị akwa na bọọdụ ide akwa dị adị maka mgbaziri, ọbụlagodi ma otu anọghị anọ n'ime ụlọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: A small water fountain can be a helpful addition to a room. Many rooms have a central water feature, such as a fountain or a small pool, which can add a sense of tranquility and beauty, even if there are no other water features in the room.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na igwe ndetị akwa adịghị adị, ma ọ bụ ọ bụrụ na ọ masịghị gị iyi sọks edere ede, mgbe ahụ ị nwere ike ịnwa iji otu igwe ịkọ ntutu, ma ọ dịrị.
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have a regular pair of stockings, or if you don't like the ones you have, you can try using a pair of tights instead.

translations.source: Kpachara anya ka akwa ghara ịdị oke ọkụ (nke a nwere ike ime ka akwa hịkpọọ, maọbụ ọ ka njọ, o nwere ike ịgba ọkụ).
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: The bright, intense light (which could be blinding, or simply harsh, and potentially damaging)

translations.source: E nwere ọtụtụ ụzọ e ji eme ka mmiri dị ọcha, ụfọdụ kara dị ire maka ụmụ ihe iyi egwu pụrụ iche.
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are many ways to make water clean, some of which are specifically designed for use in musical instruments.

translations.source: N'ebe ụfọdụ isi mmiri n'ọkụ ruo otu nkeji ezuola, n'ebe ndị ọzọ achọrọ ọtụtụ nkeji.
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: In some cases, it takes up to an hour to fill a bathtub, while in others, it may only take a few minutes.

translations.source: Ụmụ m̀yọ̀ na-adị iche n’ịdị irè, ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwee nchebara echiche, mgbe ahụ ị kwesịrị itule uche ịzụ mmiri gị n’ime otu karama amachiri siye na otu ụlọ ọrụ nwere aha ọma.
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: The children are different in their appearance, but if you have a specific need, such as needing a bottle of water or a visit to a particular store, then you should let them know.

translations.source: Ndị njem nwere ike ịhụta ụmụ anụ ọtapịa ndị nke ha na-amaghị n'ebe ụlọ ha.
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: Guests may encounter unexpected animals in their homes.

translations.source: Pesti nwere ike imebi nri, kpata Pests can spoil food, cause mmeka ahụ, ma ọ bụ n’ọnọdụ ka njọ kpata mmeghachi omume nfụkasị, kesaa venọm, ma ọ bụ ọrịa ofufe.
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Pests can contaminate food, cause physical harm, or lead to the spread of diseases such as salmonellosis, E. coli infection, or food poisoning.

translations.source: Ụmụ ọrịa na-efe efe n’onwe ha, ma ọ bụ ụmụ anụmanụ dị egwu nwere ike imerụ ma ọ bụ gbuo mmadụ n’ike, a na-ghị etozukarị oke dị ka ụmụ ahụhụ a na-achọghị.
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Diseased individuals or dangerous animals that can cause harm or death to humans are often not recognized as such.

translations.source: Azụmaahịa na-enweghị ụtụ isi bụ ohere ịzụ ngwaahịa ndị ewezụgara site na ụtụ isi n’ụgwọ ndị ọzọ n’ebe ụfọdụ.
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: A wholesale business is an opportunity to purchase goods in bulk at a lower price than if you were to buy them individually.

translations.source: Ndị njem na-aga mba ndị nwere nnukwu ụtụ isi nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ ichekwa ọkpụrụkpụrụ ego, tụmadị na ngwaahịa dị ka ụmụ ihe ọn̄ụn̄ụ ndị na-aba n'anya na ụtaba.
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Tourists visiting countries with significant natural attractions may sometimes find it worthwhile to purchase souvenirs and other items as mementos of their trip.

translations.source: Mgbatị ụzọ nọ n'etiti Point Marion na Fairmont na-enye ọnọdụ ịnya ụgbọala kachasị taa akpụ n'Okporoụzọ Buffalo-Pittsburg, na-agafe ọtụtụ oge site n'ọdịdịala azụ ọhịa dịpụrụ adịpụ.
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The highway that connects Point Marion and Fairmont provides the most direct and convenient driving route on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh highway, offering a significant time-saving alternative to the longer, more circuitous route through the city.

translations.source: Oburu na imaatachabeghi ka esi anya ugboala n’okporouzo ime obodo, ume ahapukwala gi: uzo n’akpode akpode, uzo di wara wara na nkuku nko juru eju.
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the challenges of finding a suitable location for a new home, there are still many options available: a quiet neighborhood, a spacious property, and a convenient location near amenities.

translations.source: Ókè ekwomọsọ ebipụtara dị obere karịa n'ụzọ ahụrụ anya na ngalaba ndị ọzọ gara aga ma ndị na-abịa abịa - na-abụkarị mph 35-40 (km/h 56-64) - ma nrubeisi siri ike na ha kara dị mkpa karịa otu ọzọ.
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: The speed of this vehicle is significantly lower than that of previous models and those currently on the market – typically ranging from 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) – and its fuel efficiency is considerably better than that of its competitors.

translations.source: Na mmata ihe, n'agbanyeghị, ọrụ ekwentị mkpààgagharị ka dị ike ebe a karịa ọtụtụ ogologo ụzọ ndị ọzọ ahụ, dịka ọmụmaatụ Ọhịa Pennsylvania ahụ.
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the challenges, mobile phone networks have become increasingly prevalent here, surpassing many other forms of communication, such as the traditional postal system.

translations.source: Pastrị ndị Jamini dị nnọọ mma; na Bavaria, ọ na-enwe ọtụtụ ihe ma dịkwa iche iche ka nke ndị Ọstrịa, agbata obi ha n'akụkụ ndịda.
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: The pastures in Germany are excellent; in Bavaria, they are particularly diverse and different from those in Austria, reflecting the local conditions.

translations.source: A na-ahụkarị ụmụ achịcha mkpụrụ osisi, e ji apụl eme achịcha mgbe niile n'afọ, ejikwa cheri na plọm eme achịcha n'oge sọma.
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: Young children often enjoy playing with seeds, and they can do this every day, both indoors and outdoors.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ ngwaahịa achịcha eghere eghe na Jamanị na-egosipụtakwa njirimara ụmụ alịmọndụ, hezelnọt, na mkpụrụ osisi ndị ọzọ. Achịcha ndị ama ama na-agakarị nke ọma ya na otu iko nke kọfị siri ike.
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Various types of coffee beans are grown in Jamaica, including Arabica, Robusta, and other varieties. The most popular and widely grown variety is Arabica.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ụmụ achịcha ndị pere mpe ma baakwa ụba, nwaa ihe na-ndabere na mpaghara a na-akpọ Berliner, Pfannkuchen ma ọ bụ Krapfen.
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you are looking for delicious, freshly baked pastries, try the Berliner, Pfannkuchen, or Krapfen, which are all popular in this area.

translations.source: Curry bu nri eji ngwa nri nke di iche iche esi, ana etinyekwa ya anu ma o bu akwukwo nri.
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: Curry is a type of cuisine that uses a variety of spices and herbs to create a flavorful dish.

translations.source: Kọrị nwere ike ịdị "akọrọ" maọbụ dị "mmiri mmiri", ọ dabeere na mmiri dị adị.
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: The "rain" can be either a "shower" or a "downpour," depending on the amount of rain.

translations.source: Ụmụ mpaghara imeala nke Ebe Ugwu Indịa na Pakistan, a na-ejikarị yogọọt n'ime ụmụ kọrị; n'ime Ebe Ndịda Indịa na mpaghara ndị ọzọ dị n'akụkụ mmiri nke okpuru kọntinent ahụ, a na-ejikarị mmiri ara akị oyibo.
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: The monsoon season in India and Pakistan is a crucial time for agriculture; in the Indian subcontinent and other regions along the eastern coast of the continent, it is a period of heavy rainfall.

translations.source: Ebe enwere agwaetiti 17,000 isi wee họrọ, nri Indonesia bụ aha gburugburu nke a na-akpọ ọtụtụ erimeri nke ọtụtụ mpaghara dị na mba ahụ niile.
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: There were 17,000 islands selected, and Indonesian cuisine is a diverse range of dishes from various regions throughout the country.

translations.source: Mana, e kwuo ya n'etinyeghi nkọwa ọbụla, ihe a na-achọkarị ikwu bụ nri ahụ si n'etiti na ọwụwa anyanwu nke nnukwu agwaetiti Java.
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: Basically, when he says there's no need to worry, what he really means is that the delicious food from the middle and upper classes of the large Java city is worth trying.

translations.source: Ugbu a ọ dị adị nke ukwuu na gburugburu òtù ụmụ agwaetiti ndị ahụ, nri Ndị Java nwere njirimara nri ndị etijuru ngwa nri na mfe n’usoro, ekpomeekpo ahụ kara dị ike Ndị Java kara nwee mmasị na ya ndị nke bụ ahụekere achịcha kpuchiri, ose, shuga (tụmadị shuga akị Ndị Java) na ngwa nrị ndị ọzọ nwere usi ọma.
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: The food of the Javanese people is characterized by its use of fresh, local ingredients and simple cooking methods. Common dishes include rice, vegetables, meat, and fish, often seasoned with spices such as chili, ginger, and garlic.

translations.source: Ihe nkonye ụkwụ bụ ihe na-ejide ụkwụ onye na-agba ịnyịnya nke na-awụdata n'akụkụ abụọ site oche elu ịnyịnya.
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: The heel is the part of a shoe that supports the foot and prevents it from slipping sideways.

translations.source: Ha na-ewetara onye na-agba ha nnukwu nnọsi ike mana ha nwere ike inwe nsogbu nchekwa maka na ụkwụ onye na-agba ya pụrụ ịkpachi n'ime ha.
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: They are eating a large, powerful fish, but they may have a problem with keeping it from escaping.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na esị n'elu ịnyịnya tụpụ onye na-anya ya mana ụkwụ onye ahụ ekonye n'ekike ịnyịnya, ịnyịnya nwere ike ịsekpụrụ ya na-aga ma ọ gbaa ọsọ. Iji belata ihe egwu a, enwere ụfọdụ ihe mkpachapụ anya enwere ike ime.
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: If someone is standing on a slippery surface but their feet are firmly planted, they may be able to maintain their balance and avoid falling. To prevent this from happening, there are a few things that can be done.

translations.source: Na mbụ, ọtụtụ n’ime ndị na-anya na-eyi akpụkpọ ụkwụ ọnyịnya ndị nwere kọị kọị na okpuru dị nrọ ma pee mpe.
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, many of the dancers wore brightly colored, sequined costumes and high heels.

translations.source: Ọzọ, ụfọdụ sadụl, ọkachasị sadụl Bekee, nwere ebe nchekwa na-ekwe ka akpụkpọ anụ si na sadụl dapụ ma onye na-anya anya sere ya laa azụ mgbe ọ na-ada.
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, some species, particularly those found in North America, have a protective mechanism that allows them to survive in harsh environments. This often involves the ability to enter a dormant state when conditions become unfavorable.

translations.source: Ndagwurugwuru Cochamó - ebe arimelu nwere ogo kachasị elu nke Chile, a mara dị ka Yosemite nke Ndịda Amerịka, ya na ụdị dị iche iche nke ụmụ nnukwu ahụaja kọnkịrị na nnukwu nkume.
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: Cochamo Valley - this is the highest point in Chile, often referred to as the "American Yosemite," and features a variety of stunning rock formations and large boulders.

translations.source: Ụmụ ọnụ ugwu kachasị elu gụnyere nlenle ndị magburu onwe ha site n'elu ebe ndị ahụ. Ndị na-arị elu si n'akụkụ ụwa niile na-awapụta mgbe niile ụzọ ọhụrụ site n'ahụaja ya niile e nwere ike isi wapụta ụzọ nke anaghị agwụ agwụ.
translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: The highest mountain ranges include those where people have committed suicide. People from all over the world come to these places to find new ways to live, and to escape the problems they face in their own lives.

translations.source: Kpoda-ugwu egwuregwu-snow, bu nke gunyere igba igwe mmiri ski na snowboard, bu egwuregwu amaara-amaara nke gbasara ikpoda ala site n’elu n’ogige juputara na snow jiri igwe ski na snowboard eyigidere n’ukwu gi.
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: Snowboarding is a winter sport that involves riding down a snowy slope on a snowboard, a type of board that is attached to your feet.

translations.source: Egwuregwu skii bụ otu isi ihe omume n'etiti ndị ọ na-amasị, mgbe ụfọdụ a na-amara ya dị ka "ski bums," na-eme atụmatụ nke oge ezumike niile gburugburu ime skii n'otu ebe kpọmkwem.
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing is a popular sport among enthusiasts, often referred to as "ski bums," involving navigating a snowy terrain in a controlled manner.

translations.source: Egwuregwu ski eteela ọ nọ — ụmụ eserese esere n'ọgba kemgbe 5000 BC na-egosi ndị egwuregwu ski!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: Skiing originated in the mountains — with evidence of skiing dating back to 5000 BC, showing that skiing has a long history!

translations.source: Igwu skii na mgbada ugwu dị ka otu egwuregwu gara azụ ruo opekata mpe ọ bụrụ na arị afọ iri na asaa, ma n’ime 1861 òtù egwuregwu skii ntụrụndụ nke mbụ bụ nke emepere site n’aka Ndị Nọọwei n’ime Ọstrelịa.
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Rugby is a sport that has been around for centuries, with its origins dating back to the 19th century. However, the first organized rugby match was played in 1861, when a team of Scottish students played against a team of English students in Melbourne, Australia.

translations.source: Njem mfe ski: A na-akpọkwa omume a bakkọntrị ski, ije nlegharị anya ski maọbụ ịrị ugwu ski.
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing: This refers to the activity of gliding down snow-covered slopes on skis, using poles for balance and steering.

translations.source: O metụtara mana ọ naghị agụnyekarị ọdịdị njem nleta ski keugwu ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ịrị elu ugwu, nke ikpeazụ ndị a e mere n'ọdịdịala kpodara ekpoda ma na-achọ ụmụ ski na buutu kara sie ike.
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: It was a challenging experience, but I was able to overcome the obstacles and successfully complete the ski run, which involved navigating steep slopes and icy conditions.

translations.source: Chee echiche maka ụzọ esi egwu egwuregwu skii dị ka ụzọ e si aga njem ije nke yiri.
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: I'm looking for ways to play ski, just like I learned to drive a car.

translations.source: N'ọnọdụ dị mma i nwere ike ịgarute ntoanya buru ibu karịa ịga ije - mana ọ na-ara ahụ tupu i rute ekwomọsọ nke ime skii ofe mba n'enweghị otu akpa azụ dị arụ n'ime mkpọwaraụzọ akwadogwere.
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: In a good situation, you might be tempted to take a shortcut – but it's important to remember that cutting corners can lead to serious problems down the road, such as a poorly constructed building with no proper foundation.

translations.source: Yurop bụ kọntinent dị obere na mmetụta ma nwee ọtụtụ mba nwere onwe ha. N’okpuru ọnọdụ nkịtị, ime njem gafee ọtụtụ mba ga-apụta ị ga site na ntinye akwụkwọ maka visa na njikwa paspọọtụ ọtụtụ oge.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a small continent with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, traveling between these countries would involve obtaining visas and dealing with various passport requirements.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị, mpaghara Schengen na-arụ ọrụ dịka mba a na-akwanyere ugwu.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: Essentially, the Schengen area functions as a single country for travel purposes.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọrọ n'ọgbọ a, i nwere ike igafe oke ala ma zere nnyocha paspọtụ.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: If you are participating in this activity, you may be able to access restricted areas and avoid security checks.

translations.source: N'otu aka ahụ, site n’inwe otu visa Schengen, ị kwesịghịzi itinye akwụkwọ maka visa otu n’ime mba ndịòtù Schengen nke ọ bụla iche, ya mere chekwa oge, ego na mmepe akwụkwọ.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: In this context, with a single Schengen visa, you should not include application documents for a visa to any of the Schengen countries within the same application. Therefore, it is important to plan your trip, budget accordingly, and organize your documents carefully.

translations.source: Onweghi nkwekọrịta zuru ụwa maka ngwa a na-akpọ ihe ochie. Ụfọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ụtụ na-akpọ ngwa ndị karịrị afọ 100 ihe ochie.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no international agreement on the definition of "antique" goods. Some businesses classify items that are over 100 years old as antiques.

translations.source: Nkọwasị ahụ nwere ọdịiche kwa ọdịdị ala, ebe ókè afọ nwere ike ịdị obere karịa n'ebe ndị dị ka Ugwu Amerịka karịa n'ime Yurop.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The climate varies depending on the region, with the north experiencing colder temperatures than the south, which is similar to the climate in North America compared to Europe.

translations.source: Enwere ike ikpo ngwaahia eji aka ruo ihe mgbe ochie, n’agbanyeghi na o di ohuru karia ngwaahia ndi nke emere maka oha.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: The old, worn-out shoes were no longer suitable for wearing, as they were too small and uncomfortable.

translations.source: Ọzụzụ Reindeer dị mkpa nke ukwuu ọkachasị n’ime ihe banyere ndụ na omenaala ndị Sámi nakwa ahịa gbara ya okirikiri dịkwa mkpa maka ọtụtụ akaọrụ ndị ọzọ.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: Reindeer herding is extremely important, especially in relation to the lives and livelihoods of the Sámi people, and it also represents a significant economic activity for many other communities.

translations.source: Ọbụna n'ọdịnala, agbanyeghị, ọ bụghị Sámi niile bụ ndị metụtara n'ime nnukwu ogo ọzụzụ anụmanụ reendiya, mana biri site n'igbu azụ, ịchụ nta na ihe yiri ya, na-enwe reendiya n'ọtụtụ oge dị ka ụmụ anụmanụ akpọbatara.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: Traditionally, reindeer herding has not been a common practice, but it is now becoming increasingly prevalent, with many people engaging in it as a livelihood.

translations.source: Taa ọtụtụ Sámi na-arụ ọrụ n’ụmụ ahịa nke ugbu a. Njem nleta bụ mkpata egọ dị mkpa na Sápmi, mpaghara Sámi ahụ.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, many Sámi people are working in the tourism industry. Reindeer herding is a vital part of Sámi culture, and a significant industry in the region.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị na ndị abụghị ndị Roma na-ekwu ya n'etiti ha, a na-ahụta aha a bụ "Gypsy" dị ka aha ọjọọ maka na ọ gbasara ụfọdụ ụzọ ọjọọ ndị ọzọ si ahụta ndị Roma, nke abụghị eziokwu.
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: While the term "Gypsy" is used by non-Romans to refer to this group, it is considered offensive because it is based on false stereotypes about the Romani people.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na mba ahụ ị ga-aga ileta bụrụ nke nọ n'okpuru otu ndụmọdụ njem, mkpuchi ahụike njem gị ma ọ bụ mkpuchi nkagbu njem gị bụ nke o nwere ike imetụta.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: If the country you are traveling to has a different set of travel regulations, your health insurance or travel insurance may not be valid there.

translations.source: Ị nwere ike ịjụta ndụmọdụ nke ndị ọchịchị karịa nke gị, mana ndụmọdụ ha bụ ndị e mebere maka ndị amaala ha.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: You may find that the advice of government officials differs from your own, but their advice is intended for the people they represent.

translations.source: Iji mee atụ, ndị Amerịka nọ na Mịdụl Ist nwere ike igabiga ihe dị iche n'ihe ndị Yurop maọbụ Arab ga-agabiga.
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: In addition, the Americans living in Middle Island may have different preferences than Europeans or Arabs when it comes to food.

translations.source: Ndị ndụmọdụ gasị bụ naanị obere nchịkọta nke ọnọdụ ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’otu obodo.
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: Town hall meetings are a small-scale form of local government in a community.

translations.source: Uche ndị e gosipụtara na-esekarị n'elu, n'izugbe na ntọghasị dị ukwuu ma a tụnyere ya ozi ndị a kọwara nke ọma dị ebe ọzọ.
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: The images displayed are clear and vibrant, and they provide a much more informative and engaging experience compared to the written descriptions.

translations.source: Ajọ ihu igwe bụ aha izugbe a na-akpọ ihe ọbụla gbasara ihu igwe nke nwere ike imebi ihe, ghasaa mmekọrịta, maọbụ gbuo mmadụ.
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: A solar flare is a sudden release of energy from the Sun that can disrupt communications, damage satellites, and even cause harm to people.

translations.source: Ihu igwe dị oke njọ nwere ike ime n'ebe ọbụla n'ụwa, ma o nwere ụdị dị iche iche, nke nwere ike idabere na ọdịdịala, ọdịdịebe na ọnọdụ keikuku.
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: A severe thunderstorm can occur anywhere in the world, but they come in different forms, depending on the atmospheric conditions, such as temperature, humidity, and wind speed.

translations.source: Ụmụ oke ifufe, mkpụrụ mmiri, oke mmiri ozuzo, na ọkụọhịa bụ ụmụ ụdị na mmetụta nke ihu igwe dị oke njọ, dị ka ụmụ egbe eluigwe mmiri ozuzo, ajọọ̀ oke ifufe, ajọọ̀ ifufe mmiri, na ajọọ̀ oke mmiri ozuzo.
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Clouds, raindrops, lightning, and thunder are all manifestations of severe weather, such as thunderstorms, heavy rainstorms, and lightning storms.

translations.source: Ihe ihu igwe siri ike na-eme na mpaghara na n'oge ụfọdụ gụnyere blizadị, oke ikuku na ọdịda ibubeoyi, oke ikuku na ọdịda aịzị, na oke ifufe na-ebu aja.
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: The atmospheric pressure fluctuates in a localized area over time, resulting in changes in air pressure and temperature, such as sudden drops in air pressure and temperature, as well as gradual increases in air pressure and temperature.

translations.source: Ana adusi ndi njem odu ike ha mara gbasara ihe ndaba nke ekpem-oku maobu di oke ukwuu nke na emetuta ogbe ha dika onwere ike imetuta atumatu ime-njem obula.
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: The strong currents of the river pose a significant danger, as they can easily sweep people away and cause serious injury or even death.

translations.source: Onye ọbụla na-achọ ịga mba ọbụla bụ ọgbọ agha kwesịrị ka e kuziere ya etu e si eme ya.
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone who wants to travel to any country should first obtain the necessary visa and other travel documents.

translations.source: Ọchịchọ n'ịntanetị maka 'Ọmụmụ gburugburu keiro' nwere ike iweta adreesị otu ụlọọrụ imeobodo.
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: The use of online platforms for "environmental awareness campaigns" can help to identify and address specific housing issues.

translations.source: Otu ihe ọmụmụ ga-akọwa nke ọma ihe niile a kọwara ebe a tinyekwa ahụmihe bara uru.
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: This section will provide a clear and comprehensive explanation of everything mentioned here, along with valuable insights.

translations.source: Ihe ọmụmụ na-abụkarị site na ụbọchị abuo ruo ụbọchị ise ma ọ ga-emetụta mmepụta omume, ọtụtụ mgbata ọsọ enyemaka mbụ na ọzụzụ maka ngwaagha n'oge ụfọdụ .
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: The training period typically lasts from two to five days and includes initial instruction and practical training in various skills.

translations.source: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na magaziini ndị na-akọ maka nlanarị nke ọzara juru eju, mana ụmụ mbipụta na-akọ maka ebe a na-alụ agha dị obere.
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: Books and magazines often depict war in a grand and dramatic way, but this particular account focuses on a smaller, more personal conflict.

translations.source: Ndị njem ụgbọ mmiri na-eme atụmatụ ịwa ahụ ntụgharị mmekọahụ na mba ofesi ga-ejiriri n'aka na ha ji ụmụ akwụkwọ ziri ezi maka njem nlaghachi.
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: The cruise ship passengers are preparing for their return journey to their home countries, and they are making sure to have all their belongings properly packed for the trip.

translations.source: Ịdị njikere ndị ọchịchị inye akwụkwọ ikike ngafe ndị a na-edepụtaghị jenda ha (X) maọbụ dọkụmentị emelitere ka ọ daba n’aha a chọrọ ma jenda adị iche.
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: I am writing to request that the authorities provide official documentation confirming that the individuals (X) or documents in question are indeed who they claim to be, and that the information provided is accurate.

translations.source: Njikere nke ndị ọchịchị mba ndị ọzọ ịsọpụrụ akwụkwọ ndị a dị nnọọ ka ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The reactions of other government officials to these documents have been varied and complex.

translations.source: Ọchịchọ na ebe nyocha nchedo abụrụkwala oke nsogbu mbanye n’ike n’ime oge Septemba 11, 2001 gachara.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: The attacks on September 11, 2001, caused widespread devastation and loss of life.

translations.source: Ndi transgender n’emebeghi oparashon atubekwana anya na ha gafecha ihe nyocha na ha ka ga ano na nzuzo ma ugwu ha adikwachim.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Transgender individuals often face discrimination and prejudice, and they may experience difficulty accessing healthcare and other essential services.

translations.source: Oke ọchịchị mmiri bụ mmiri na-asọlata asọlata site n'ebili mmiri tikapụrụ n'ọnụ, na-emekarị n'okwute ala mmiri maọbụ ihe yiri ya.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: A swamp is a wetland area characterized by shallow water, often found in low-lying areas or near bodies of water.

translations.source: N'ihi tọpọlọjì nke okpuru mmiri ahụ, mmiri na-abanyeghachi dị ike n'akụkụ ole na ole miri emi, ma ike ọwụwụ mmiri ngwa ngwa ruo na mmiri dị omimi nwere ike ịmepụta n'ebe ahụ.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the high salinity of the water, the water level fluctuates significantly, and the potential for saltwater intrusion into freshwater sources is a serious concern.

translations.source: Imirikiti ọnwụ na-eme n'ihi ike ọgwụgwụ n'ịgbalị igwughachi azụ megide kọrenti mmiri, nke nwere ike ọ gaghị ekwe omume.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: The main cause of pipe bursts is the pressure exerted by water trying to flow through a pipe that is too small or damaged.

translations.source: Ozugbo ị na-esi n'ọwụwụ mmiri ahụ pụta, igwughachi azụ na-aka ara ahụ karịa na nkịtị.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: As the water level rises, the mud becomes increasingly difficult to walk on.

translations.source: Gbalịa tụọ atụmatụ ọzọ maka ebe ejidebeghi gị, maọbụ, dabere na nka gị yana ma achọpụtala gị, ị nwere ike ịchere maka nnapụta.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Please consider requesting a different location for your event, or, if your event is based on art and self-expression, you may wish to request a more suitable venue.

translations.source: Mmenyeụjọ mbanyegharị abia na nkpirikpi karia mmenyeụjọ omenala (enwere agba họnịịmuunu dịtụ ntakịrị), dịruru ogologo, ma nwee ike ịka njọ.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: The iridescent butterfly, with its vibrant and intricate patterns (ranging from subtle to strikingly bold), is a long-lived insect capable of remarkable flight.

translations.source: Ndị njem ndị nwere oge dị mfe ịnọgharị n’omenala ọhụrụ mgbe ụfọdụ na-enwe oge siri ike ịnọgharịkwa n’omenala keobodo ha.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Some people find it easy to adapt to new environments, while others struggle to return to their familiar surroundings.

translations.source: Mgbe a na-alaghachite n’ụlọ mgbe e bichara n’obodo oyibo, ị nweela mmara ahụ nye omenala ọhụrụ ahụ ma tufuokwa ụfọdụ agwa gị si n’omenala nke ụlọ gị.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: When you are walking through your house after a visit to a foreign country, you may notice new things about your own home and also remember some things you saw in the foreign country.

translations.source: Mgbe ị gara na mba ofesi na mbụ, ndị mmadụ nwere ike ha nwere ndidi na nghọta, na-amara na ndị njem nọ n'ime mba ọhụrụ chọrọ imegharị ahụ nnọshị̀.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: When arriving in a new country for the first time, people may find it difficult to understand the local customs and traditions, leading to misunderstandings and conflicts with the native population.

translations.source: Ikekwe ndị mmadụ agaghị atụ anya na ndidi na nnagide bụ ihe ndị njem na-alaghachi ụlọ aghaghị inwe.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: People might not realize that the quiet and peacefulness of a journey home can be a welcome contrast to the hustle and bustle of daily life.

translations.source: Ihe ngosi uda na oku piramidi bu ihe kachasi akpalite mmuo emere maka umuaka n’ebe a.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: The most impressive structure in this area is the pyramid, which is a significant monument built for the ancestors.

translations.source: Ị nwere ike ịhụ piramidi n'ime itiri ma ị nwere ike ịhụ ha n'ịgbachi nkịtị tupu ihe ngosi ahụ ebido.
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
